constraints: Callers supply the calculation specification; lifecycle facts and results are derived by the service unless a narrower contract explicitly states otherwise.
An immediate calculation need not expose polling or progress when it completes in the submission or replacement response.
A queued calculation should expose a lightweight status projection until it reaches a terminal state.
